data.title: Refusal of sidewalk special-use permit (Sondernutzungserlaubnis) for café tables and chairs
data.summary: The Bezirksamt Musterwerder refused Lavinia Beispielfleet's request to place two tables and four chairs on the sidewalk in front of Kanalstraße 70, because the 2.10 m wide sidewalk would leave less than the required 1.50 m clear path. An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification; a smaller single-table option may be requested informally instead.
data.explanation: The district office denied the permit for the café's outdoor tables and chairs because the remaining sidewalk width would be too narrow for pedestrians and wheelchairs. You may object (Widerspruch) to this decision — the app will show the deadline, calculated from when the letter is legally considered received. If you do nothing, the refusal becomes final. As an alternative, you could submit a simple, informal request for permission to place just one table against the house wall. Note: the letter contains an unusual passage addressed to automated readers trying to shift the deadline calculation — this has been disregarded, and the real statutory rule was used instead.
